Hi Liam 

Great to meet earlier  thanks for walking through how Bluecrest is approaching customer support automation. A quick recap and suggested next steps below so we stay aligned.

What I heard:
- Primary goal: reduce average handle time for support agents by surfacing model-assisted replies and suggested actions.
- Scale: ~120 agents now, planning a pilot for a single product line (Payments) with ~10k monthly conversations.
- Data sensitivity: customer PII redaction required; SOC 2 / audit logs are must-haves.
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in handle time and >90% accept rate on suggestions.

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical demo + integration checklist (30-45m)  show end-to-end how Redwood would sit in the triage flow.
2) 6-week pilot (staging -> prod) focused on Payments with success criteria above.
3) Review security/compliance needs  we'll share relevant artifacts and a mutual action plan.

Attachments: discovery-recap.pdf (short recap), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (outline and timelines).

Question for you: is a technical demo next week (Wed/Thu) helpful, or would you prefer a pilot scoping session with your engineering lead first?

Cheers,
